description: Anthropic Messages checks (anthropic profile). Paths are relative to <base>/v1; headers x-api-key and anthropic-version are added automatically.

checks.title: GET /v1/models returns a data array of {id}
checks.fix_hint: Some Anthropic-format clients discover models through GET /v1/models with x-api-key + anthropic-version headers. Return {"data":[{"id":"...","type":"model"}],"has_more":false}.

checks.title: The tested model id is listed by /v1/models
checks.fix_hint: List every model id callers can send to /v1/messages.

checks.title: Non-stream message has type=message, content blocks and stop_reason

messages.content: Reply with the single word OK.

checks.fix_hint: Return {"type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"text","text":"..."}],"stop_reason":"end_turn","usage":{...}}. Check that x-api-key and anthropic-version headers are accepted (not only Authorization: Bearer).

checks.title: Non-stream message reports usage input/output tokens
checks.fix_hint: Report usage.input_tokens and usage.output_tokens (and cache_* fields when caching is used). Claude-style clients use them for context and cost display.

checks.title: system as an array of text blocks with cache_control is accepted

messages.content: Reply with the single word OK.

checks.fix_hint: Coding agents send system as a list of blocks with cache_control. Accept the array form; if the upstream has no prompt caching, ignore cache_control instead of rejecting it.

checks.title: Stream uses named SSE events in the Messages order

messages.content: Reply with the single word OK.

checks.fix_hint: Send `event: <type>` plus `data: {"type":"<type>",...}` for message_start, content_block_start, content_block_delta, content_block_stop, message_delta, message_stop (ping is optional). Anthropic streams do not use [DONE].

checks.title: message_delta carries stop_reason
checks.fix_hint: message_delta.delta.stop_reason (end_turn, max_tokens, tool_use, stop_sequence) tells agents whether to run tools or stop.

checks.title: Stream reports input tokens in message_start and output tokens in message_delta
checks.fix_hint: Put usage.input_tokens in message_start.message.usage and the final usage.output_tokens in message_delta.usage.

checks.title: Forced tool_choice returns a tool_use block

tools.name: get_weather
tools.description: Get the current weather for a city.

messages.content: What is the weather in Jakarta? Use the tool.

checks.fix_hint: Return a content block {"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_...","name":"get_weather","input":{...}} where input is an object, and stop_reason "tool_use".

checks.title: tool_result can be sent back and answered
checks.fix_hint: Accept a user turn with [{"type":"tool_result","tool_use_id":...,"content":...}] after the assistant tool_use turn, and keep tool_use_id intact through any format translation.

checks.title: Unknown model gives 4xx with an Anthropic-style JSON error

messages.content: Reply with the single word OK.

checks.fix_hint: Return 404 (or 400) with {"type":"error","error":{"type":"not_found_error","message":"..."}}. Never an HTML page or a 5xx.

checks.title: Invalid x-api-key gives 401/403 with a JSON error

messages.content: Reply with the single word OK.

checks.fix_hint: Return 401 with {"type":"error","error":{"type":"authentication_error","message":"..."}} and never echo the key.
